row_legend.sets: count, radius, center (3), normal (3), least distance to the faces, faces touched (bits: 2 axis + side), max norm, spread, off plane
row_legend.q: one character per nested surface, inner to outer: |q| when liftable, x pierced, g gap at or under 0.2, l lift not consistent
row_legend.ar: 1 where the surface surrounds the loop
row_legend.en: number of sets the surface surrounds
row_legend.loop: index of the loop in sets (largest clear set, else largest set)
row_legend.dev: largest distance of |q| from a whole number
